historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds board/PCI mapping but lowers capability for inputs.

original_test_intent: Validate each onboard LAN Type 41 Reference Designation as the approved board/silkscreen label for the PCI function identified by that record, with valid string reference and reboot stability.
original_method: Validate Type 41 length and Reference Designation string index, bind the exact label to the record's status/type and segment:bus:device.function identity, compare with the approved board/PCI map and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: An engineer may establish the authoritative physical silkscreen map once; supplying that expected map does not make the repeatable Type 41-to-PCI comparison manual.
required_inputs: Expected onboard LAN reference label per segment:bus:device.function
Approved enabled/disabled, absent and duplicate-label policy
Type 41 layout/string parser and read-only PCI inventory
Approved reboot with console/BMC recovery independent of tested LAN
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/PCI queries; do not disable, bind/unbind, reconfigure or flash LAN devices.
Validate the raw string index and exact label before normalization.
Correlate by Type 41 BDF identity rather than output order or interface name.
Do not auto-retry reboot; stop if network recovery is incomplete and use approved OOB.
agent_execution_scope: Validate Type 41 length/string, decode status/type/BDF, correlate each LAN function to the approved label map and read-only PCI identity, then diff across reboot.
Report dangling, duplicate, mislabeled, missing or drifting records without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the physical board-label/BDF map, disabled-device policy and reboot recovery path.
Adjudicate board-revision label exceptions and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove raw string reference, record length or ownership by the intended onboard LAN PCI function.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw/decoded Type 41 and read-only PCI inventory; emit handle, exact designation, status/type, BDF, PCI identity, expected label and pre/post result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The onboard-LAN designation scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; no network reconfiguration is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate the Type 41 string reference, decode its BDF and device state/type, compare to the approved board-revision label map and stable PCI inventory across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing Type 41 records for onboard LAN devices.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, board revision, BIOS, parser/dmidecode, kernel and PCI utility versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 41 Reference Designation and PCI address fields plus owner board drawing/label map.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw string integrity and unambiguous PCI-function ownership.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects labels copied to the wrong LAN function, invalid indices, duplicate mappings and BDF drift.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: PCI inventory proves device identity but not the physical printed label; the owner-supplied board map remains authoritative.

project_override_considerations: Projects may provide a board-revision-specific label map and disabled-device expectations, but must preserve the exact source label and BDF identity.
expected_evidence: Approved board revision, LAN label/BDF and disabled/duplicate policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 41 handles/lengths/string indices and exact labels
Decoded status/type/BDF with read-only PCI identity and label-map result
Statement that no LAN/driver/firmware state changed
Approved reboot/network/OOB record and post-reboot identity-bound diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Reference Designation is a valid Type 41 string field narrowed by Items to onboard LAN; the board map is an execution baseline.

blocked_analysis.analysis: String/BDF/PCI comparison is fully automatable after the expected physical label map is supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds string integrity, fixed-layout and BDF/PCI ownership validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its board-map safety/coverage while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Treats the authoritative label map as an input rather than manual core execution.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible designation from passing when it belongs to a different onboard LAN function or an invalid string reference.
independent_technical_reasoning: The designation is meaningful only as a relation among exact Type 41 string, record state/type, PCI BDF identity and the approved board-revision label map.
